reasons: Claimed status is compliant and the proposal correctly leaves the text unchanged with no counterparty comment, which is the expected output for a compliant finding.

The cited paragraphs (Section 4.1 license fees and the Exhibit B pricing/revenue-share lines) contain only fixed fee figures and percentages with no 'most favoured', 'no less favourable', 'best price' or third-party-matching language, so no MFN obligation burdens Corio (our side, the Customer/Licensee).
The rule's preferred position — no MFN obligation on Customer — is satisfied by the absence of any such clause; detection guidance expressly directs no redline where the Customer bears no MFN burden.

Rationale is coherent and non-overreaching: it identifies the sections reviewed (fees, grant of rights, shared resources, sales/marketing exhibit) and notes no Vendor-granted MFN either, so nothing needs preserving.
No deterministic check failures and zero changed characters, consistent with a compliant, evidence-only finding.
